name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is an exploration-stage company operating a three-pronged model of mineral royalty creation, precious metals streaming, and an exploration project accelerator in Nevada. The company holds royalty and exploration interests in multiple properties within Nevada's Walker Lane gold trend, including the Lapon Canyon Gold Project and the Agai-Pah Property. Nevada Canyon acquires undervalued or underdeveloped mineral properties, funds exploration, and monetizes assets through joint ventures and royalty retention.
